description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Agilathas Sivakkolunthu as a member of the Northern Province Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Jaffna
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Northern Province Provincial Council due to a member being elected to Parliament. It details the process of nomination by a political party and the subsequent declaration by the Commissioner of Elections. The content is entirely focused on an electoral process and the composition of an elected council, making it a clear fit for the Elections category (Type 7).
